messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's dependency outage — want to assign owners for postmortem actions and set realistic timelines.
dev-bot: Incident 2026-09-03-P2 logged. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/incident/2026-09-03 :spiral_note_pad:
ryan: root cause summary: cloud control-plane rate-surge -> token refresh 5xx -> registry retrier amplified renewals -> TTL fallback absent.
sophia: proposed actions: client-side tenant limiter + backoff (owner: ryan, eta: 2026-09-07), registry safe-TTL + circuit-breaker (owner: sophia, eta: 2026-09-14), multi-region canary (owner: ops-sre, PoC: 2026-09-06).
kevin: I'll own vendor escalation & SLA ask (eta: 2026-09-17). please include request for their control-plane mitigation steps and on-call contact.
ryan: quick snippet for client limiter PoC: `rate_limiter = LeakyBucket(max_qps=5); backoff = ExponentialBackoff()` will go in PR.
ops-sre: canary design: lambda in each region posts to /refresh and does a tiny model ping every 5m; PoC logs to prometheus.
maria: ops trend: 5 auth blips in last 6 months around vendor maintenance windows. recommend monthly "auth-path" drill owned by ops-sre rotation; first drill: 2026-09-21.
sophia: CI test action: inject 429/5xx into auth path to validate client backoff + registry CB (owner: sophia, eta: 2026-09-10).
ryan: estimate hours: client limiter 8h; sophia: registry CB 12h; ops-sre: canary PoC 4h; kevin: vendor comms 3h.
maria: I'll run weekly 15m closure triage (Weds 09:15 PT) until high-priority items closed and will centralize tracker link after I create it. react with :eyes: when you confirm.
all: :eyes:
